_comment: Per-profile teardown/startup contract. Read by ui/profile_metadata.py. The ui/device_ownership.py preflight handles the implicit case (serials computed from the combined config) — this file is for the explicit case (decoders that must be stopped or started by name regardless of serial overlap). Each profile id maps to a dict with optional keys: requires_stop (list of systemd unit names to stop before the new profile takes effect), starts (list of systemd unit names to start after rtl-airband settles), claims_serials (list of RTL serials this profile reserves; merged with the combined.conf scan).

acars._description: ACARS / VDL2 decoder mode. Releases the ground RTL from rtl-airband and runs acarsdec + dumpvdl2 directly against it.

radiosonde._description: Radiosonde scan mode. Runs radiosonde-auto-rx against the ground RTL.

hp3_favorites_airband._description: Managed favorites airband profile. Explicitly displaces wx decoders that may have been left running by a prior ground profile.

hp3_favorites_ground._description: Managed favorites ground profile. Same displacement contract as airband — favorites mode does not run any wx decoder.

none_airband._description: No-op airband profile (silences device #0). Should free any wx decoder that may have been claiming the airband RTL.

none_ground._description: No-op ground profile (silences device #1). Frees wx decoders unconditionally.
